text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek put up a valiant fight against 
strong rivals, but unfortunately fell just 
short of victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek took the results in stride, 
resolving to grow steadily without 
rushing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she looks back on the days 
leading up to this moment, viewing them as 
trials to help her grow alongside her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as her next goal, she spoke of her 
desire to run in the Osaka Hai.
